note: Raids and theft on the house (roadmap item 61, first part; core/game/game_raids.gd). A house that keeps animals can be raided as the years pass: each whole year the world clock crosses rolls on dice keyed on the dynasty seed and the year (never the dynasty's own). The chance rises with what there is to take (the stock's value) and falls with the guards (GameRanch.guard_cut). A raid is an event the heir settles (events.json, the ones marked raid): trust the guards, ride out and fight, pay, or try a trick. A house that keeps no animals is never raided.

text.beaten_off: The guards drive the {who} off. Nothing is lost.

text.stole_gold_saved: The thieves get away with {gold} gold. The guards saved {saved}.
